rationale: Pharmaceutical butylphthalide and isosorbide mononitrate factorial comparison in lacunar stroke. Disability and headache are primary outcomes. No dried celery leaf or Parkinson visual hallucination measure.
Isolated luteolin or placebo in schizophrenia. Clinical psychopathology and positive symptom scores do not establish a visual hallucination outcome after dried celery leaf in Parkinson disease.
